comments: just to add more context, in webkit browser the above code does not work, aka the custom header does not get passed to the redirected url, not sure if this is a bug too

review_comments: The headers are not propagated in firefox apparently (other similar tests also disabled). We can tackle that separately.
I think this whole `if` block might not apply to overrides, because we continue them right away, and will received extra info from the network stack at some point. Should we follow up?
We already handle overridden headers in that case in Request.headers/rawRequestHeaders
